INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES — TERMLY EXAM #16
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Reading 3.2.1 Extensive Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Reading 3.2.1 Extensive Reading.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 3.2.1 Extensive Reading.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 3.2.1 Extensive Reading.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Reading 3.2.1 Extensive Reading.

2. When practising Reading 1.2.1 Reading for comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 1.2.1 Reading for comprehension.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Reading 1.2.1 Reading for comprehension.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 1.2.1 Reading for comprehension.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Reading 1.2.1 Reading for comprehension.

3. When practising Listening and Speaking 4.1.1 Public speaking – Impromptu speech, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 4.1.1 Public speaking – Impromptu speech.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 4.1.1 Public speaking – Impromptu speech.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 4.1.1 Public speaking – Impromptu speech.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 4.1.1 Public speaking – Impromptu speech.

   A. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for information.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for information.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for information.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for information.

6. In INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Only memorise without using the language
   B. Avoid speaking to classmates
   C. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day
   D. Mix random languages with no purpose

7. When practising Writing 1.3.1 Essay writing – Expository essay, which approach is best? (1 mark)

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
12. In three clear sentences, explain Reading 9.2.1 Reading for information and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
